extracted.name: Feta Cheese Fried Flatbread
ingredient_lines: 3 cups all purpose flour plus extra for dusting
1 cup hot tap water plus more if needed
As needed vegetable oil to fry in
instruction_lines: Mix the flour with the spices. Add in the butter and hot water. Form the dough when mixed break up the feta cheese. Mix the feta and dough.
Heat oil. When the dough and cheese is incorporated roll it out on a dusted area. Fry it till done. Move to paper towels to absorb excessive amounts of oil.
